name: Cold Call
source:
It's been 6 months since Trisha moved out of her family home. Every night since then, she's had awful nightmares that she barely remembers the next morning.

What are these horrible visions and why won't they leave her alone?

[From [url=https://cicadaqueen.itch.io/cold-call]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
特丽莎搬出家已经六个月了。从那时起，她每天晚上都会做可怕的噩梦，第二天早上她几乎不记得了。

这些可怕的幻象是什么？为什么他们不让她一个人呆着？

[来自[url=https://cicadaqueen.itch.io/cold-call]Itch.io[/url]]
